items.response: I'll add the guard as a hook scoped to the org route group, not the whole app. Action: find where the org routes are registered, add a global preHandler or middleware there that requires x-org-id, checks it against the orgs in the session, rejects with problem+json using the existing helper, and add tests for missing header, wrong org and the happy path.

I don't know how it's exposed yet and don't want to make something up for the conversation with Priya. Action: search the infra and helm config for the ingress, load balancer and certificate setup, and write you a short summary of how traffic reaches the api and what renews the cert.

The signature has to be made on the server because the HMAC secret can't ship to the browser, so the preview component will call a server-side function. Action: implement signing and verification in apps/web/lib/share-link.ts over invoice id plus expiry (constant-time compare, reject expired links), read the secret from env following the repo's convention, and call it from the preview component's copy share link button.

Let me look at how the dropdown is built before choosing a fix. Action: find the org switcher component, check whether it's a library popover or hand-rolled with its own open state, fix the outside-click close, and add a test that clicking outside closes it.

I'll keep the job's behavior the same but stop swallowing the error. Action: open the pdf render job's catch, find how the repo already reports exceptions and logs, add both with the invoice or job id as context, add a test that a render failure is reported, then commit it.

Stripe signature checks need the exact raw bytes, which a parsed JSON body doesn't preserve. Action: register fastify-raw-body for /v1/webhooks/stripe only, use the raw body when verifying the signature, add a test with a signed payload, and run it; the webhook settings page docs and the acme webhooks test secret handling I'll treat as separate items unless you want them in this change.

Two parts: run only what a change affects, and cache results between runs. I won't add the bench as a CI job, per your rule. Action: read the CI workflow files and the root package manager and build config, then propose path filtering or an affected-only filter plus dependency and build caching, and show the plan before editing; the PR will need a CODEOWNERS approval.

Monospace will stop the jumping, and tabular-nums would help in any font. Action: find the invoice number and amount columns in the invoices table, apply a monospace class with tabular numbers, load JetBrains Mono through the app's existing font setup, and check the table visually.
